title: FormKrafter form spec
description: A form is a tree of bricks. The same document drives the builder, every renderer and server-side validation, and is portable JSON with no FormKrafter-specific encoding.

type.description: What role the node plays in the tree.

id.description: Which registered brick renders this node, for example "text", "select", "data-grid".

name.description: Human label for the node, shown in the builder.

dataType.description: The JSON type the brick's value takes. Validation rules are only enforced when it is present.

editable.description: Whether the builder lets this node be edited. Defaults to true.

unWrapData.description: Whether the brick's value is spread into the parent record rather than nested under its key.

isPrivate.description: Hides the brick from the builder palette.

validators.description: Validators the brick offers in the builder. The rules actually enforced live in "validations".

configsForm.description: A spec describing the brick's own configuration form, used by the builder.

styles.description: Style tokens applied to the brick, as CSS-like key/value pairs.

children.description: Child bricks. A collection's children describe one repeating row.

message.description: Overrides the built-in message for this rule.

value.description: The rule's argument: a number for min/max and lengths, a regular expression source for pattern. Absent for required, email and url.

customValidator.description: Sandboxed expression evaluated when validator is "custom".

logic.description: A JsonLogic expression, evaluated against the form data merged with the host's runtime context.

code.description: Source evaluated in the AST sandbox when type is "javaScript".

target.description: The property the rule drives, for example "hidden", "disabled", "value".

configs.description: Brick configuration. Only key and uid are defined for every brick; each brick id adds its own, so unknown properties are allowed on purpose.

key.description: The field's name in the form data. A brick without a key holds no value.

uid.description: Identity of the node while the builder is editing it. Stored specs do not need it: the builder hydrates missing ones and strips them from everything it emits.

defaultValue.description: Seeded into the form data on load for keys the host did not supply.

localizedText.description: Either a plain string, or an object keyed by locale.
